source: Intermediate short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: جارتنا أم خالد كانت ست كبيرة وطيبة.
sentences.en: Our neighbor Um Khaled was an old and kind lady.

sentences.ar: كل يوم كانت تقعد عالباب وتسلم عالناس.
sentences.en: Every day she used to sit by the door and greet people.

sentences.ar: كانت تعرف كل واحد بالحارة باسمه.
sentences.en: She knew everyone in the neighborhood by name.

sentences.ar: لما كنت صغير، كانت تعطيني حلوى.
sentences.en: When I was little, she used to give me sweets.
And she used to tell me stories from the old days.
Once, she got sick and stayed home for a week.
All the neighbors visited her and brought her food.

sentences.ar: لما طابت، رجعت تقعد عالباب من جديد.
sentences.en: When she got better, she went back to sitting by the door again.

sentences.ar: أم خالد كانت روح الحارة كلها.
sentences.en: Um Khaled was the soul of the whole neighborhood.
